Pagination.use: move through a paged result set

rules.range: Pagination always shows the first and last page, keeps siblings pages around the current one, and collapses longer gaps to an ellipsis.
rules.control: Pagination is controlled: it renders the given page and reports changes through onPageChange; it does not own page state.
rules.labels: Set previousLabel/nextLabel/label when the default English accessible names don't match the page's language.
